class.name: IfcInterceptor
class.brief_description: An interceptor is a device designed and installed in order to separate and retain deleterious, hazardous or undesirable matter while permitting normal sewage or liquids to discharge into a collection system by gravity. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcInterceptor defines the occurrence of any interceptor; common information about interceptor types is handled by IfcInterceptorTyp
